blocks.text: Section 1103.3, Flood hazard areas, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:
Additions and foundations in flood hazard areas shall comply with TMC Chapters 14.20 (building code) and 17.30 (floodplain management).
